prompt: Name a part of the human body

notes: Painters only; famous sculptors (Rodin) don't count, but Michelangelo painted the Sistine Chapel.

prompt: Name a cooking utensil, pot, pan, or kitchen gadget
notes: Hand tools, cookware, bakeware and countertop gadgets. Big built-in appliances (fridge, oven, dishwasher) don't count.

prompt: Name a signer of the Declaration of Independence
notes: The 56 men who signed the Declaration in 1776. Washington, Hamilton and Madison did not sign it.

prompt: Name a book of the Bible
notes: The 66 books of the Protestant Bible, plus the Catholic and Orthodox extra books (Tobit, Maccabees...). Numbered books count separately.
